title: Using the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only)
question: Using the subnet with ID `012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48` (IPv4 only) and considering only routes whose next hop is `10.30.19.197/8`, return the subnet name, the range and variance of allocation-pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) across its IP allocation pools, the dense-rank of its associated standard attribute when ordered by the standard attribute UPDATED_AT timestamp using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, and also include the subnet CIDR and gateway IP. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH subnet_info AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS subnet_id,
        s.name AS subnet_name,
        s.cidr AS subnet_cidr,
        s.gateway_ip AS gateway_ip,
        sa.updated_at AS standard_attr_updated_at
    FROM subnets s
    JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = s.standard_attr_id
    WHERE s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
      AND s.ip_version = 4
),
pool_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.subnet_id,
        MAX(p.first_ip) - MIN(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
        VARIANCE(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
    FROM ipallocationpools p
    WHERE p.subnet_id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
    GROUP BY p.subnet_id
),
ranked_subnets AS (
    SELECT 
        si.subnet_id,
        si.subnet_name,
        si.subnet_cidr,
        si.gateway_ip,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY si.standard_attr_updated_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS standard_attr_dense_rank
    FROM subnet_info si
)
SELECT 
    rs.subnet_name,
    ps.first_ip_range,
    ps.first_ip_variance,
    rs.standard_attr_dense_rank,
    rs.subnet_cidr,
    rs.gateway_ip
FROM ranked_subnets rs
JOIN pool_stats ps ON ps.subnet_id = rs.subnet_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM subnetroutes sr 
    WHERE sr.subnet_id = rs.subnet_id 
      AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
);

    WHERE s.id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
      AND s.ip_version = 4
),
pool_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.subnet_id,
        MAX(p.first_ip) - MIN(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_range,
        VARIANCE(p.first_ip) AS first_ip_variance
    FROM ipallocationpools p
    WHERE p.subnet_id = '012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48'
    GROUP BY p.subnet_id
),
ranked_subnets AS (
    SELECT 
        si.subnet_id,
        si.subnet_name,
        si.subnet_cidr,
        si.gateway_ip,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY si.standard_attr_updated_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS standard_attr_dense_rank
    FROM subnet_info si
)
SELECT 
    rs.subnet_name,
    ps.first_ip_range,
    ps.first_ip_variance,
    rs.standard_attr_dense_rank,
    rs.subnet_cidr,
    rs.gateway_ip
FROM ranked_subnets rs
JOIN pool_stats ps ON ps.subnet_id = rs.subnet_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM subnetroutes sr 
    WHERE sr.subnet_id = rs.subnet_id 
      AND sr.nexthop = '10.30.19.197/8'
);
